label: early copy steps (recall 1-2) of long sequences, fed back x/3/o/l/c/z
explanation: Active only in the copy phase: never on original-phase or <DEL> steps, and never on recall_idx 0. 88% of activation mass is on the 2nd and 3rd copy outputs (recall_idx 1-2, i.e. the input is orig(0) or orig(1) fed back), and rate rises with L (L=9 holds 48% of mass). Within those steps the input token matters: x, 3 and o are strongest (4-6x lift), then l, c and z, while t and e are weak. It fires only on inputs that already appeared earlier (in_first=0). The top activations (~0.14) are x/o/3/l fed back at recall 1-2 in L=9 sequences. Steps that satisfy all of these still often stay inactive, so some other unidentified factor (not out_tok, next_out or in_count) gates it. Precision and recall both plateau near 0.3.
